joke.title: FIRST TASK
joke.subtitle: STAND UP
rules: Write three stand up jokes from your character's perspective.
Your jokes are saved. Later, one character at a time takes the stage.

perf.title: PERFORMANCE
perf.subtitle: ON STAGE
rules: One character's jokes are on stage.
Comment and engage for 3 minutes. Messages arrive after a 10 second delay.
Then everyone gives a secret thumbs up or thumbs down. A majority of thumbs up earns the performer a point.
